item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 23/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will bring slightly cooler weather to the coast of southern China over the weekend and early to midweek next week. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will cover southern China. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of next week, temperatures will fall over the region.
